title: FEEDBACK WITH A SCREENSHOT
why: His answer 38: in-game feedback in the ESC / TAB menu, a typed note plus a screenshot. The pause box had a note field that only went into the run report, with no picture of what you were looking at. It now has a FEEDBACK button: it takes a screenshot of the game as it stands and opens a window with the picture and a note field (type at once, CTRL+ENTER saves, ESC cancels; a controller reaches SAVE and CANCEL). SAVE writes your note with the version, the time and where you were, plus the picture: on his own machine into the exports folder through the collector, otherwise as two downloaded files. Nothing in your save changes, so it works in the demo too.
now: FEEDBACK in the pause menu saves a typed note with a screenshot.
